accra-international-marathon|2026-10-25.summary: A coastal marathon through Accra's beach communities, finishing at Labadi Beach Hotel.

Marathon.note: 2026 organiser schedule confirms the full marathon starts at 05:30 local (GMT, UTC+0) on Teshie Road near Family Health Hospital, opposite KAIPTC. Arrive at the start 30 minutes beforehand. The 04:30 hotel shuttle departure is not the race start. Registration closed at noon GMT on 24 October; no race-day registration. Schedule corroborated by the organiser's AIM 2026 entry page on ACTIVE.
